people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Rapha
people.line: Ancestor of Philistine giants; his descendants fought against David's warriors.
